dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we not taking the boat this time?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: It's nice to walk from time to time, isn't it? Think of it as something like a hiking trip.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Once we're there, we can stay a few days before we return.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Sounds good... I haven't walked this road in a long time.
